hints.title: What does postfix mean?
hints.body: An operator applies to the two most recent values that have not yet been combined.

hints.title: Use a stack
hints.body: Push numbers. On an operator, pop the right operand first, then the left operand.

hints.title: Order matters
hints.body: For subtraction and division, compute `left - right` and `left / right`, not the reverse.
